what_this_is: What this is: the structured result of round 1 of the wood-from-your-maps job (summary, method, controls, scores, repeat and seam evidence, pictures, failures, untested). Written at the end of the round; the guides in this folder hold the full text and tables.
summary: Built one Blender recipe (recipe/wood_from_maps_recipe.py + wood_node_kit.py + settings.json, 888 nodes) that uses the uploaded wood height map and colour map only as source material and arranges new boards from them with nodes only: 5 rows per tile (cut gap-middle to gap-middle from source rows R2-R5), boards of random length, each board a random window (source row, start, flip left-right/upside-down, zoom, tone) read at the SAME position from height and colour, ragged dirt-and-pebble cracks and dark row bands that hide every cut, stain stamps from the map, large soft colour patches, rationed knots. Default tile (tiles_across=1) repeats exactly; tiles_across 2/4/8 gives new boards everywhere. MAIN colour from the colour map, COMPARISON colour from height via a 32-step palette. Normal made from the arranged height (two-neighbour slope, strength 8; this is what reproduces the uploaded normal to 0.004). Same-kind score vs reference wood: MAIN 0.801 mean of 3 seeds, COMPARISON 0.715, earlier pure-node wood best new tile 0.665. The material is reused (each used source dot about 22 times in 16 tiles; 20-30 percent of board-size pieces have a near copy vs 100 percent for a plain repeat); knots come back (24 knot boards in 16 tiles from only 2 usable knots). Guides, sheets and all numbers are in the folder.
method: Research numbers (research/measurements_wood_source_map.json) -> numpy-free node build with a small Python kit (wood_node_kit.py: Python sums become Math nodes, frames, Color Ramp tables, White Noise 4D hash). Recipe frames: 0 PLACE, 1 ROWS (5 rows, heights vary 5 percent, sum to one tile, row strips from gap middle to gap middle), 2 BOARDS (3 per row, lengths 0.4-1.6 x 418 dots, row shifted sideways, half of neighbour pairs joined with a partial crack), 3 WINDOW (source row = row offset + board slot so neighbours never share a row; start in knot-free stretch or containing K2/K3; flips, zoom +-10 percent), 4 READ (one position, height and colour Image Textures, Linear, Ping-Pong keeps windows inside the non-wrapping map), 5 STAINS (two shifted stamp layers, dark part only), 6 JOINTS AND GAP BANDS (ragged cracks with dirt, pebbles, lip; band on every row boundary hides row cuts and the tile edge), 7 PATCHES (donut noise in the tile), 8 COLOUR, 9 HEIGHT/ROUGHNESS. Tile vs area by one switch (hash index modulo boards per row / tile, or global). tools/run_jobs.py bakes many pictures per Blender run through lib/bake_harness.py (not changed); the recipe sets a narrow pixel filter and 1 sample when one picture dot = one source dot. Checks: score with lib/texture_compare.py (3 seeds, MAIN and COMPARISON, plus the earlier recipe's best tile seed 105 re-baked and scored the same way), pixel_compare for transparency, source-unchanged test, half-tile slide test at 1254, 2x2 repeated tile seam test, shift test and source-reuse count on a 4x4 area from exact 'which source dot' pictures, research near-copy test, full-size crops, a full-size crop of every joint (75), lit raking-light pictures, sweeps. About 26 Blender runs were used (a few were stopped early or wasted).
controls: All in recipe/settings.json as group.control (defaults in the recipe file < settings.json < --params). recipe.tiles_across 1/2/4/8 (1), recipe.tile_repeats -1/0/1 (-1 auto), recipe.seed (1); layout.rows_per_tile 4-6 (5), row_height_variation 0-0.2 (0.05), boards_per_row 2-4 (3), board_length_variation 0-0.8 (0.6), joined_share 0-1 (0.5), joined_max_length 0.3-0.9 tile (0.72); windows.zoom 0-0.2 (0.10), flip_left_right 0-1 (0.5), flip_upside_down 0-1 (0.4), knot_share 0-1 (0.12; at most one knot board per tile-wide stretch of a row); boards.tone_variation 0-0.6 (0.24), warmth_variation 0-0.3 (0.12), height_shift 0-0.3 (0.10); joints.width 0-12 dots (4), gap_band_width 0-10 (4), raggedness 0-1 (0.8), notches 0-1 (0.8), edge_lip 0-1 (0.5), pebbles 0-1 (0.8), edge_shade 0-1 (0.35), wobble_length 8-60 (22); stains.amount 0-1 (0.18), size 40-120 dots (85), zoom 0-0.4 (0.25), dark_limit (135/255), dark_softness (55/255); masks.drift_amount (0.10), drift_size (2), blotch_amount (0.15), blotch_size (5), darken_height 0-1 (0 = patches change colour only); colour.source map|height_palette (map), colour.palette (32 stops); roughness.base 0.78, from_height 0.20, board_variation 0.04; bake.exact_dots 1, shrink_samples 8, shrink_filter 1.0; debug.source_unchanged 0/1; source.* = measured facts about the maps. Special parameters: shift [u,v], window [x,y,size in tiles], debug_view boards/rows/flips/source_x/source_y, settings_file. Sweep pictures (boards per row, joined share, stains, knots, patches, rows/zoom/joint width) in sheets/. Settings audited with lib/description_audit.py (3.2 KB, passes).
scores: Same-kind score vs reference wood at 1254 dots (overall / colour / height / normal / tiling). MAIN seed 1: 0.816/0.763/0.868/0.787/1.0; seed 2: 0.809/0.779/0.851/0.726/1.0; seed 3: 0.778/0.736/0.826/0.704/1.0; MEAN 0.801/0.759/0.848/0.739/1.0. COMPARISON seed 1: 0.742/0.613/0.859/0.787/1.0; seed 2: 0.709/0.577/0.837/0.726/1.0; seed 3: 0.695/0.571/0.810/0.704/1.0; MEAN 0.715/0.587/0.835/0.739/1.0 (height and normal are the same files as MAIN; the colour map adds about +0.17 on the colour group). EARLIER wood recipe best new tile (its seed 105, re-baked from its description and scored the same way today): 0.665/0.655/0.634/0.588/1.0. MAIN seed 1 beats the earlier tile on 12 of 14 measures, equal on seam, worse on colour_spectrum (0.463 vs 0.587); COMPARISON colour_spectrum is only 0.150. Pixel numbers (transparency only, boards are not where the reference's are): colour SSIM 0.199/0.204/0.200 (MAIN), 0.209 (COMPARISON), 0.201 (earlier); colour Delta E 15.6/15.6/15.7, 14.8, 14.2; tier 'none' for all; normal angle about 34-35 degrees. Other facts: colour-brightness vs height correlation 0.978-0.979 (uploaded maps 0.982); MAIN vs COMPARISON colour Delta E 4.7 mean (11.0 at 95th percent); heights of two seeds correlate 0.04. Earlier tuning sweeps (earlier version): zoom/row variation cost about 0.016, stains 0.02, large patches 0.05; 2 boards per row 0.763 vs 3 boards 0.800.
repetition_evidence: 4x4 area (5016 dots across, baked at 2508). (1) Shift test (correlation of the picture with itself slid): one tile across 0.082 (down 0.027, diagonal 0.024; colour brightness 0.043) against 0.972 / 0.836 / 0.812 for the plain uploaded map repeated 4x4; the background of other sideways shifts reaches up to 0.096 and random shifts up to 0.04, so one tile and one map width are not special; the default tile repeated on purpose gives 0.996. (2) Source reuse from exact 16-bit 'which source dot' pictures: 72 percent of the source dots are used (row R1 not by design, R4 only 60 percent), a used dot appears about 22 times (median 20, 90th percent 44) in 16 tiles; 227 boards, every board shares at least half of its source piece with another board (an unavoidable consequence of 4 usable rows), closest pair sharing 80 percent is 0.19 tile apart, median distance of pairs sharing half is 2.1 tiles, 13 percent are closer than one tile; knots: 24 knot boards in 16 tiles (K2 16, K3 8), closest two of the same knot 0.45 tile apart. (3) Research near-copy test (40 patches 36x80 at 1024 dots): new area 20 percent of board-size patches have a near copy (colour brightness 30 percent; feature size 53-57 percent) vs 100 percent for the plain repeat; with parts switched off (height, 1024-dot areas): windows only 35 percent, no stains/patches 28 percent, default 12 percent, 2 boards per row 33 percent, 4 boards per row 5 percent, knot share 0.5 12 percent (40 patches, differences under about 10 points are noise). Research's own earlier pieces-only numbers were 47-53 percent. So: no repeat at tile/map width and no board looks the same side by side, but the material is reused about 22 times and distinctive features (two knots, big cracks, stain clusters) do come back. No person has judged this; I looked at the 4x4 and at full-size crops.
seam_evidence: Half-tile shift test at 1254 dots (the whole pattern slid by half a tile vs the normal bake slid by half a tile): colour mean absolute difference 0.0018 (0.07 percent of dots differ by more than 0.1), height 0.0007 (0.2 percent), wrong-slide control 0.106 / 0.235. Default tile repeated 2x2 at 2508 dots: jump across the vertical tile line 0.99 (colour) / 0.94 (height) times a typical jump, horizontal tile line 0.31 / 0.09 (the tile line is itself a row boundary hidden in a dark band; the largest ordinary row boundary jump is 2.46 / 3.41), mean difference between the four tiles 0.0019 / 0.001; the project's tiling measure gives 1.0 (seam ratio 0.52-0.56 vs 2.24 for the uploaded map). Source-unchanged test (arrangement off): height differs from the uploaded height by 0.00003, normal made from it differs from the uploaded normal by 0.0039/0.0039/0.0041, identical to the same rule on the uploaded height itself. Every board joint (75 full-size crops over 3 seeds, sheets/joints_seed1-3.jpg) was looked at: the crack hides the cut in all; weak points: some joints very straight, round evenly spaced pebbles, about 6 soft dark horizontal smudges next to joints where a stain stamp caught a dark crack of the source. Full-size crops of the 4x4 area across tile lines (sheets/area_crops.jpg) show no tile line.

failures: First joints were flat black bars that looked drawn; replaced by ragged cracks with dirt, pebbles and a lip.

Rows cut gap-top to gap-top put wood against wood at every row boundary: the project's tiling score was 0.19 then 0.0 although the half-tile slide test passed; fixed by cutting gap-middle to gap-middle and laying a dark band on every row boundary (tiling 1.0).
Two of the first eight stain stamps contained knots (K2, K4): the knot came back as a smaller second knot in the same board; stamp centres replaced.

Masks that also darkened the height lowered the height scores; patches are colour-only now. Everything on lowered the same-kind score (0.76 vs 0.85 with none, earlier version); amounts were lowered, the defaults are a compromise.
Two boards per row scored lower (0.763 vs 0.800, earlier version) and repeats more (33 vs 12 percent near copies): default is 3 with half of the pairs joined.
'At most one knot per row' gave 4x too few knots per dot in a bigger area; found by counting; fixed with one draw per tile-wide stretch (24 knot boards in 16 tiles now).
Neighbouring boards could take the same source row and show a mirrored 'butterfly' across the joint (2 of 25 joints in seed 2); fixed by giving every next board the next source row.
My first board count for the reuse test used a dithered colour debug picture (1107 'boards' instead of about 230); now read from an exact 16-bit picture.

My job list once wrote into the wrong folder (relative paths); files moved and the driver fixed; two long runs were stopped and restarted after changes; about 26 Blender runs in all (budget about 25). One rm -rf with a glob was refused by a safety check at first (not needed; the later removal of my own leftover folder by explicit path worked).
A rule in the research notes was mislabelled: the uploaded normal equals the two-neighbour slope of the height at strength 8 (0.004), not a 3x3 Sobel (0.03).

Remaining weak points: soft dark smudges where a stain stamp catches a dark crack; many joints are full-height straight cracks (the real joints of the map are partial and stepped); the surface reads as a wall of boards more than as one log wall; same two knots, big cracks and stain clusters come back; looks only as good as the source map; comparison colour spectrum score is weak (0.150).
untested: No person looked at the pictures for 'does it repeat'; the near-copy numbers are the research's own measure.
Only seeds 1-3; sizes: 8x8 area only at 512 dots, nothing larger; tiles at sizes other than 1254 not baked (area bakes at 2508).

Settings not swept: joints.wobble_length/raggedness/notches/edge_lip/pebbles/edge_shade, stains.size/zoom/dark_limit/dark_softness, masks sizes, boards.height_shift, roughness.*, layout.joined_max_length, board_length_variation, the palette; stricter stain limits (dark_limit 100, softness 30) suggested to remove the smudges but not tried; rows_per_tile 4 and 6 only looked at once at 640 dots.

Roughness map only looked at as a picture (lit pictures use constant roughness for both); the normal of an arranged surface has no reference to compare with (only the unchanged-source pipeline check).
Other Blender versions, GPU, use as a material on a 3D mesh; shared slate layers not used; the 'LATER - realistic moss and damage' test was not started as instructed.

The standard harness command was run for seed 1 at 1254 dots on an earlier version of the recipe and on the final recipe at 512 dots (tests/cli_check); the final 1254 bakes used the same bake_recipe function through tools/run_jobs.py.
